decision_rule.target_alive_if: A3 target confirmed, D1b direction-positive, M3234 interface pricing positive, and priced tail-MSE reduction >= 0.15.
decision_rule.representation_alive_if: M3235 target-path smoke passed and M3236 true-family validation reconstruction MSE <= 1e-12.
decision_rule.local_pretrain_closed_if: M3236 quick pretrain failed, worst required rare-family validation accuracy < 0.5, and predicted-family reconstruction gate failed.
decision_rule.next_process: If target and representation are alive but local pretraining is closed, admit only a read-only family-selector/separability repricing milestone; no training or C2 admission.
